ingredients.name: scallions, green onions, rinsed and finely chopped
salmon fillet, cut into 6 portions, 4 ounces each

steps.instruction: Whisk 1 cup of sour cream, 2 teaspoons of dill and 3 tablespoons of scallions in a bowl.
Whisk in 2 tablespoons of Dijon mustard and 2 tablespoons of lemon juice.
Lightly coat a baking sheet with cooking spray.
Place 6 portions of salmon fillet, skin side down, on the baking sheet.
Sprinkle the salmon with 1/2 teaspoon each of garlic powder and pepper.
Spread the sauce over the salmon.
Bake for 20 minutes, until a thermometer reads 145 °F in the thickest part.
steps.spoken: Bake for about 20 minutes, until each piece is opaque in the center and flakes easily with a fork in the thickest part. A thermometer should read at least 145 °F.
